prompt: Load the manual rotary switch circuit, turn the pointer to 1, then to 2.
note: Book I Experiment 11, Manual Operation of Rotary Switch (printed p.21 = book1.pdf PDF p.23). Turning the pointer is `dial hold <degrees>`: position k is k x 22.5 degrees, and on MV601-REF-A contact 1 holds from about 15 to 30 degrees and contact 2 from about 37.5 to 52.5 (measured with minivac-control, 2026-11-02). A dial step matches a dial hold at any angle and its checkpoint carries the position, so a pointer on the right contact passes whatever angle put it there. Both checkpoints are I-EXP11's own expects for positions 1 and 2. No fixture that uses the dial is tier A; I-EXP11 is tier C1, verified, five cords.

expect.cite: BK1 printed p.21 = book1.pdf PDF p.23
expect.quote: Light 5 comes ON and remains ON as long as the pointer points at number 1.

expect.cite: BK1 printed p.21 = book1.pdf PDF p.23
expect.quote: Rotate the pointer to number 2. Light 5 goes OFF and light 6 comes ON.
